compiled_state.title: Add audit_dd3_mutation_caps.py per-pass cap verifier
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-3: Per-pass mutation count <= phase cap (10 strict, 100 throttle); audit emits per-pass series; fail if any pass exceeded cap

Create plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/audits/audit_dd3_mutation_caps.py. Sources audit_dd4_phase_gate.sh via subprocess CLI. Reads reconciler pass-log (--pass-log path), parses per-pass mutation counts, applies cap (10 for strict passes 1-5, 100 for throttle passes 6-8). Writes .reconciler-audit-artifacts/<phase>/dd3.json with {phase, passes: [{n, cap, count, within_cap}], overall_pass}. Exits 5 if any pass exceeds cap.

## Test Approach
Given pass-log fixture all 8 passes within cap; When audit_dd3_mutation_caps.py runs; Then dd3.json overall_pass=true + exit 0. Given pass 7 reports 150 mutations (>100 cap); Then within_cap=false for pass 7, overall_pass=false, exit 5.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] ruff: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/audits/audit_dd3_mutation_caps.py
- [ ] All-within-cap fixture: overall_pass=true, exit 0
  Verify: pytest tests/unit/dso_reconciler/audits/test_audit_dd3_mutation_caps.py::test_all_within_cap
- [ ] Throttle-pass-over-cap: overall_pass=false, exit 5
  Verify: pytest tests/unit/dso_reconciler/audits/test_audit_dd3_mutation_caps.py::test_throttle_over_cap
- [ ] Strict-pass-over-cap (>10): overall_pass=false
  Verify: pytest tests/unit/dso_reconciler/audits/test_audit_dd3_mutation_caps.py::test_strict_over_cap

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/audits/audit_dd3_mutation_caps.py — Create
- tests/unit/dso_reconciler/audits/test_audit_dd3_mutation_caps.py — Create

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)

comments.body: REVISION_CYCLE_1: Pass-log format clarification — pass records are stored as per-pass JSON files at bridge_state/snapshots/<pass_id>.pass_record.json (NOT an aggregated log). audit_dd3_mutation_caps.py reads ALL pass_record.json files in bridge_state/snapshots/, correlates by pass_id naming convention (pass_id format: phase=<phase_name>_n=<pass_number>_ts=<timestamp> or equivalent — confirm with applier.py canonical form), determines pass_number from filename or from {phase, n} fields in the JSON, applies cap (10 for phase=bootstrap-strict n=1..5, 100 for phase=bootstrap-throttle n=1..3). CLI: audit_dd3_mutation_caps.py --pass-log-dir <path-to-bridge_state/snapshots/> --phase <phase>. Cross-language coupling justification (subprocess CLI for gate): the phase-gate is sourced by 4 bash callers (audit_dd1, dd2, dd5 + Makefile); replicating gate logic in Python would create drift risk between the 5 callers. Subprocess CLI maintains single source of truth. Add AC: check audit_dd4_phase_gate.sh is executable before subprocess invocation; fail with clear diagnostic otherwise.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: REVISION_CYCLE_2: Enumerate RED test specs explicitly: (a) test_pass_count_over_cap_exits_5 — fixture pass_record.json with count=150 for phase=bootstrap-throttle n=7 (cap=100) → exit 5, within_cap=false in dd3.json. (b) test_all_passes_within_cap_exits_0 — fixture all 8 passes ≤ cap → exit 0, overall_pass=true. (c) test_per_pass_series_schema — dd3.json has passes: [{n: int, cap: int, count: int, within_cap: bool}] exactly matching documented schema. (d) test_strict_phase_cap_10 — fixture pass_record.json with count=12 for phase=bootstrap-strict n=3 (cap=10) → exit 5. (e) test_missing_pass_log_dir_fails_closed — --pass-log-dir points to non-existent path → exit non-zero with diagnostic.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: AC amendment (gap analysis): pass_record.json schema PIN — required keys: phase (string), pass_index (int), mutation_count (int), timestamp (ISO8601). Schema source: upstream bootstrap.py / reconcile.py emission point. Add RED test test_pass_record_schema_strict: fixture pass_record.json missing 'mutation_count' field → exit non-zero (KeyError surfaces as prerequisite failure, NOT silent 0-mutation pass). If schema not yet pinned upstream (draft-7 reconcile.py owns it), this task has prerequisite dependency: confirm bootstrap.py emits all 4 fields before task-4 RED tests can run. Rationale: validation-class audits that silently pass on schema drift are highest-risk failure mode for this story (implicit_assumption).
